roadmap.title: Runs today on OpenRouter's Decisions API

items.name: Perplexity Decider V1 27B
items.note: $0.04 per 1M input tokens. Open weights (Apache-2.0); answers all three question types and reads images.

items.name: Cloudflare Clef and Clef Flash
items.note: $0.24 and $0.09 per 1M input tokens. Open weights (27B and 9B), so they can run both hosted and locally.

items.name: Upstage Solar Decide
items.note: $0.05 per 1M input tokens. 524K context, for a long-state track.

items.name: Inception Mercury Decide
items.note: Free. A diffusion model, so mainly a latency test.

items.name: Kev 4B
items.note: $0.042 per 1M input tokens. English only, 8K context, open weights.

items.name: Together Tev1 4B Experimental
items.note: Choice questions only (2 to 24 options), so it runs on a subset.

items.name: Respan Span-01 and Span-01 Lite
items.note: Yes/no questions only, aimed at judging conversations.

items.name: Fastino GLiDE
items.note: Same request shape on Fastino's own API, so only the base URL and key change. $0.15 per 1M input tokens.

items.name: Fastino GLiNER2.5-Decide and multi-Decide
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. 340M open-weight models; the multi version is multilingual.

items.name: Laya Multilingual
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. The base model of both Arabic fine-tunes, so the fair control for them.

items.name: vLLM Semantic Router Decision-2.0
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. Six sizes from 0.6B to 27B: a model-size sweep on one recipe.

items.name: Plain chat-model baselines
items.note: The same base models as Luna Decisions and Clef Flash, prompted for JSON. Shows what decision training adds.

items.name: GLiClass Multilang
items.note: Open weights on Hugging Face. Small zero-shot classifier trained on 20 languages including Arabic: a cheap multilingual floor.

items.name: Community distills
items.note: Unofficial open models trained to imitate decision models: JEV-9B, GEV-26B-Decide, the Mapika decider family and wfzyx/von. Worth a run once they have model cards and licences.

items.name: Other leaderboards
items.note: JevBench and Decision Index publish decision-model results to cross-check ours against.
